title: Real-time collaboration engine, local-first
summary: Many people edit one vector document at the same time, also offline; every replica converges to the same state without locks (state-based LWW CRDT), behind a relay tree that sees only ciphertext.

capacity.comment: Measured by `convergence` (simulation) and `relay-load` (TCP); the planner divides by these. Update with every release.

components.name: root-relay
components.role: sequences one document; sees ciphertext only

components.name: leaf-relay
components.role: fans out to its editors, filters by viewport tiles, serves catch-ups

components.name: client-core
components.role: Doc + Outbox + DocKey + Client: the whole CRDT runs on the device

edges.why: leaf mirrors the root and forwards writes; one A2A channel per leaf

acceptance.name: convergence
acceptance.note: deterministic simulation with loss, duplication, reordering, offline phases; checked against an oracle of every write

acceptance.name: tcp
acceptance.note: the real byte path: root + two leaves over TCP, sealed frames, reconnects

portability.platform_apis: none in the CRDT, the outbox or the crypto (pure Rust); the client transport is a byte stream (std / tokio TCP)
portability.hardware: none: no GPU, no special CPU feature, no secure element required
portability.formats: deltas and frames are documented byte formats (src/value.rs, src/doc.rs, src/wire.rs); a document exports as its register list

migration.users: a document is its register list: Doc::sorted_registers() exports it, Doc::apply() imports it anywhere; the outbox persists as bytes
migration.providers: the relays are plain TCP services holding ciphertext; moving off bunsenbrenner is pointing clients at another address (or tunnel); moving between relays is replaying the compacted log
migration.lock_in_left: none known in this blueprint; the document key stays with the members

threats: The relay learns metadata: which pseudonymous registers change, when, from which replica id, which belong to one shape, which is a position, and the tile of each shape. Not the content.
A member can write with a huge Lamport counter and win every register: members are trusted with the document; revocation is a new document key.
A replica that loses its clock state must take a new replica id (nonce reuse and stamp collisions otherwise).
